description: Defines nested classes and structs for FastSourceLineResolver, including serialization/deserialization methods, and the Module class for symbol and address resolution in a debugging context.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver::Line
classes.description: Represents a source line with deserialization from raw memory.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver::Function
classes.description: Represents a function with deserialization and a range map of lines.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver::PublicSymbol
classes.description: Represents a public symbol with deserialization.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver::Module
classes.description: Handles symbol resolution, map loading, and frame info retrieval.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Deserializes data from raw memory into class members.

methods.name: LookupAddress
methods.description: Resolves a relative address to a stack frame.

methods.name: LoadMapFromMemory
methods.description: Loads symbol map data from memory buffer.

methods.name: IsCorrupt
methods.description: Checks if the symbol data is corrupt.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves Windows frame info for a given stack frame.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CFI frame info for a given stack frame.
